metadata.title: Monochromatic Pink Portrait with Glass Texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-glamour, monochromatic pink portrait featuring a subject with long hair and latex gloves, viewed through a vertical pane of glass covered in condensation and water droplets. The composition uses a split-screen effect where the left third is obscured by the wet glass and the right two-thirds shows the subject clearly against a smoky, atmospheric background.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic pink palette across skin, hair, and background
Contrast between sharp facial features and blurred, wet glass texture
Vertical division between the textured foreground and the clear subject
High-shine highlights on latex and skin reflecting studio lighting
coreInvariants: Water droplet texture on the left vertical pane
Subject's direct gaze toward the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-right, medium shot from the waist up, filling the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the high-shine latex glove in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the arm to the latex glove, then shifts left to the textured glass pane.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right edge and top corners are filled with pink smoke/mist, providing breathing room for the vertical text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout; value contrast is driven by bright white highlights against deep pink shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title is hand-drawn, thick-stroke script with a marker-like texture
Secondary text is a clean, geometric sans-serif with extreme vertical tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters have rounded terminals and varying pressure
Sans-serif letters are perfectly uniform and spaced widely

composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the wet glass pane

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, textured script and rigid, geometric vertical sans-serif.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the right-side text
Hand-drawn feel of the left-side text

candidateDirections.reason: For the clean geometric vertical text
For the textured title on the glass

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic pink glamour portrait of a woman with long pink hair and pink latex gloves, with a vertical pane of wet glass on the left third of the frame. The background should be smoky pink.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a hand-drawn marker-style script title on the left over the glass texture, and a clean, vertically-stacked geometric sans-serif name on the far right edge with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic pink?
Is the glass texture only on the left third?
Is the right-side text vertically stacked?
Does the latex have a high-gloss sheen?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any existing artist names or logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure glass blur doesn't obscure the subject's face
